The *Pulinapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 324) is a verse text preserved in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Like other poems in the *Apadāna* collection, it relates the past meritorious karma and biographical account of the elder (thera) Pulinapūjaka. SuttaCentral records five translations of the poem across five modern languages [SuttaCentral].

No direct external parallels are cataloged for the text on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus also records weak cross-linguistic alignments with the Chinese *Bieyi za ahan jing* (T 100), though these represent machine text-reuse matches rather than established historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
